newsitem.title: USA: PDS Financial unit wins Nevada license.
newsitem.headline: PDS Financial unit wins Nevada license.

text.p: PDS Financial Corp said its subsidiary in Nevada won a license to own, possess and distribute gaming and associated devices in that state.

The company said the license will improve its efficiency and allow it to fully implement its SlotLease program for casino operators. SlotLease is a gaming equipment leasing program that PDS Financial says offers lower monthly payments, off-balance sheet financing and flexible trade-in/upgrade provisions.
PDS Financial provides financial services to casino operators and gaming equipment manufacturers.
Its shares closed up 29/64 Friday at 2-1/4.
